label: preflight
command: import json,os,sys,socket,subprocess,importlib.metadata as m,cpn; from pathlib import Path; p=Path("<WORKSPACE>/.t26/tmp/preflight.sock"); assert not p.exists(); s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); s.bind(str(p)); s.listen(); a,b=socket.socketpair(); a.close(); b.close(); s.close(); p.unlink(); print(json.dumps({"python":sys.version,"executable":sys.executable,"cpn":str(cpn.__file__),"dependencies":{x:m.version(x) for x in ["pytest","jsonschema","packaging","websockets","numpy","scipy"]},"native_unix":True,"pytest_env":{x:os.environ.get(x) for x in ["PYTEST_ADDOPTS","PYTEST_PLUGINS"]},"git":{x:subprocess.check_output(["git"]+args,text=True).strip() for x,args in {"origin":["remote","get-url","origin"],"head":["rev-parse","HEAD"],"tree":["rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"],"status":["status","--porcelain=v1","--untracked-files=all"],"tracking":["show-ref","--verify","refs/remotes/origin/main"],"live_origin":["ls-remote","origin","refs/heads/main"]}.items()}},indent=2))
